name: Augur of Autumn
oracle_text:
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
You may play lands from the top of your library.
Coven — As long as you control three or more creatures with different powers, you may cast creature spells from the top of your library.
blocked_sentences: Coven — As long as you control three or more creatures with different powers, you may cast creature spells from the top of your library.

needs.what: admission of the existing `distinct` value leaf into STATIC_VALUE_KEYS (src/commanderblitz/cards/loader/vocabulary.py) for `{"distinct": {"of": "power", "objects": {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"]}}}`, so a `cast_from_library_top` static (affects_player you, affects_spells types [Creature]) can carry `condition: {"cmp": ">=", "left": <that distinct>, "right": {"const": 3}}`. Coven reads CURRENT power (pumps and counters count), a derived characteristic, so the static must be evaluated outside the characteristics pipeline the way `exists_derived` is for cant_attack/cant_block -- cast_from_library_top is read at cast-offer time, outside the pipeline, so it is a candidate for STATIC_DERIVED_CONDITION_EFFECTS-style admission. The same leaf unlocks every coven static.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `distinct` with `of: power` already exists in values.py DISTINCT_OF (coven is named as its reason) but only in VALUE_KEYS for effects/triggers; it is absent from STATIC_VALUE_KEYS, so a static's `condition` cmp cannot name it (load error). `count` counts creatures, not distinct powers (three 2/2s would pass). `exists_derived` can ask whether one creature with a given power exists but cannot express 'three different powers' without enumerating every power triple, which is unbounded and an approximation.
